requirements.title: A variable denotes a designator object or an associated pointer target
requirements.definition: A designator variable is the data object denoted by the designator. A function-reference variable is the target of the pointer produced by evaluating the function reference, and that pointer is required to be associated at the reference. The rule identifies the variable; it does not license reading an undefined target.

requirements.title: A variable reference is permitted only after the variable or data-pointer target is defined
requirements.definition: A reference to a variable is permitted only when the variable is defined. A reference to a data pointer is permitted only when the pointer is associated with a target object that is defined. The events that define variables with values are those described in 19.6.5; later undefinedness remains governed by 19.6.6.
